Now leasing for 2027-2028!  Visit our website to check out our virtual tours and apply for an apartment!

Turner NW offers fully furnished studio and one bedroom apartments directly across the street from campus — ideal for anyone who wants to live alone in an unbeatable location with quick access to everything!

Located immediately next door to Virginia Tech’s North End Center, the Center for the Arts, and the Upper Quad, Turner NW places you just moments from classrooms, research buildings, campus transportation, dining, and essential services. Please look through our photos for perspectives on our location relative to campus.

Walk Times From Your Front Door!

- McBryde - 4 minutes
- Goodwin - 9 minutes
- Torgerson - 6 minutes
- DDS - 11 minutes
- The Loops - 7 minutes
- Turner Place - 4 minutes
- Burrus - 8 minutes
- Newman Library - 8 minutes
- Pamplin - 9 minutes

Rent with confidence knowing your monthly charges are straightforward and easy to understand. Your monthly statement includes rent, utilities, and parking (if desired and available) — with no monthly administrative fees or hidden service charges!

Why Students Choose Turner NW!

📍 Exceptional academic location directly across from Virginia Tech 
🏠 Private, furnished studio and one bedroom apartments ideal for studying
🧺 Free 24/7 on-site laundry facilities for residents
🛠️ Professional on-site management and 24/7 maintenance service
🚗 Reserved parking options available on a limited basis
🚶 No car?  No problem! Live right next door to campus without a daily commute or long walk 
🚌 Super convenient access to Blacksburg Transit, SmartWay bus to Amtrak station and airport, and Virginia Breeze bus stop
🛒 Close to grocery stores, restaurants, coffee shops, and daily essentials

reviewsList.text:
1.  Cost for what you get - outrageous.  Think about how much they're making on each apartment.  Do not get what you pay for.

2.  The company, CMG, is atrocious to deal with.  We had constant issues with the portal and dates and payments.  They are condescending.  They charged us $273 to paint ONE room at end of year and kept almost all of the security deposit for extremely minor issues.  A total racket.

3.  Soulless and ugly.

My son applied to stay at The Edge for the 2021/22 school year and submitted a deposit. Circumstances changed with him joining a fraternity and having to live in the frat house next year. He found a person to take his place at The Edge and his replacement submitted another deposit. The Edge refused to refund my son's deposit. The only reason given was if you back out of the contract you forfeit your deposit.  Clearly this was an opportunity to take advantage of a situation where there was absolutely no negative impact to The Edge. I highly recommend you don't conduct business with this organization or stay at their properties.

reviewsList.text: We have been very impressed with Hannah, the manager at Union Blacksburg. She has been very professional and extremely helpful during our entire rental process. Chip

The amenities are fine, slightly better than anywhere in town. However, the Wi-fi is dreadful. It’s been a year now and they are still yet to fix the issue. When it goes out, it will not return for who knows how long. Got a project due monday? Wi-fi goes out friday night you might get it back Wednesday. Not much point to all the study areas and other amenities they have when you can’t even access the online resources you need to study. It’s pointless and a waste of money. They charge wayyyyy too much to have as many issues as they do. They’re also the only place in the area with this issue.

Don't get fooled by the good reviews, they had a promotion going on and were asking everyone to submit a 5 star review in exchange of some goodies or raffle tickets or something like that....
Even though the amenities seem to be “nice”, you don’t really get to use it because you have to spend most of your time somewhere else if you need to have WIFI and get your work done
So stay away unless you want to live in a black hole where you NEVER have access to Internet because their internet service is crappy and has outages like 4x a week or after 11 PM on most nights so you basically can't get any work done and for some reason the phone service in the complex is terrible so using mobile data as a backup is not an option.
And the management keeps saying these internet outages were a "isolated occurrences" and notifies us of a 5-day scheduled internet outage and somehow still manages to cut the internet off 2 days before that to screw us even more. This place is a joke ...

As a college student, I believe the quality of amenities and living spaces are nice. Everything works properly, as expected of a new apartment complex. However, the WiFi they use is horrendous. Reviews for Single Digit are bad, and if you check other review systems, you can see that it translates to Union Blacksburg having horrible reviews as well. Mine is just one of many. There are crashes that last for days each week and has issues more times than I can count per day (WIFI shutting off for no reason, browsers taking incredibly long to load, etc). All of this is not good for a college student, and this has actually been causing more headaches than anything imaginable. I understand the fault is not with Union Blacksburg, but I've talked with people at other apartments with similar or lower price ranges, and they have no issue with WiFi, which begs the question: why do they stick with Single Digits' services? If they switch large building WiFi services, it would be a 5 star apartment. Do not come to this property if you plan on living anymore than 2 hours a day in it, because the WiFi will prevent you from doing any homework.

reviewsList.text: The Hub Blacksburg provides furnished rooms with a modern touch. There are plenty of bus stops near The Hub making the transit to campus less of a hassle.

Personally, I have not been super impressed with the quality of things at the Hub. We had to put in 3 maintenance requests the day we moved in, and still haven’t gotten them all fulfilled. However, the staff has been fairly friendly and helpful if I have questions.
My experience living at the Hub has been seamless so far. Move in was quick and made very convenient. The apartment was clean upon moving in and nothing has broken yet.
Amenties are great and facility is well managed. Staff was very nice and helpful when needed. Working staff came very quickly when we requested and solved the problem quickly.

My experience has been good, the staff are nice and the amenities are good. Convenient on the bus route and good space in the apartment is good. Only downside is that we have at least 5 lightbulbs out that have not been replaced.
I enjoy living here. The pool is very nice and the study rooms are perfect. I never hear too much noise in my room. I feel as though the rooms are spaced out very nicely.
it was really easy to move in, well organized, the rooms itself were clean as well as the bathrooms, and the staff made it easy to locate everything.

My resident experience has been good so far. I live in a duplex and have been happy with the apartment thus far. Love my apartment and all the perks it comes with. I did have some issues contacting the Hub staff. Moreover, the gym is closed again, which has been very disappointing. I lived at the Hub during my sophomore year when the gym was being renovated and going through this experience is very annoying.
Super cute. I love the room it’s so big.  The living room is huge. The tv is huge. The sofa is so comfortable. There is so much storage area.
Love the place! Super cute and modern??The kitchen is beautiful, it has an amazing pearly white island. The stove is super nice has 5 burners and all of them heat super well.

love it so modern 
supes cute 
i love living with my friends 
kitchen is fire 
love having my own bathroom 
tv is really nice 
i love the bluetooth speaker in the shower
Super cute apartment. Super clean and modern, organized. The living room tv is such a good size. The counter is cute. The washing machine works good.

So far I am pleased with the apartment complex besides the fact that the gym is under renovation since I saw that as such an asset to this complex with it not being ready for use when school starts isn't ideal. But love the modern style of the apartment, haven't had time to check out other amenities really yet but looking forward to getting by the pool and using the grills! Staff seem great and very enthusiastic and helpful
All good! We had a good move in day other than cleaning our apartment. Room is nice and seems to be going fine so far. We will see how the next few days go
Super easy move in. No problems for me personally. Everything was clean and the handoff of the materials was efficient. Really no issues to speak of
The Hub is a very nice place. The staff were helpful, and moving in was stress-free. The room was a little dirty, but nothing too bad. Just some dirt on the floor.

. The management team is incredibly attentive and professional, always quick to address any concerns or maintenance requests. The amenities are top-notch, from the well-equipped fitness center to the beautifully maintained pool and common areas. The apartment itself is spacious, modern, and impeccably clean, with high-quality finishes that make it feel like home right away.
I love all the amenities and the community that the hub fosters, I feel so at home in this home away from home. I also love all the events that help me meet my neighbors!
Very nice and new apartments. Staff and management are nice, understanding, and easy to work with. Have lived here for about 3 years and have not had a bad experience.

I LOVE the way that the HUB is receptive to improvement, and continuously betters itself to help its residents! 

Even now, telling the HUB about my Resident Experience, shows me how willing they are to listen to us! :)

Mostly love the hub. Only annoying thing was the garage being opened majority of the year. Even though they towed people it wasn’t enough, I had a parking pass and some nights couldn’t find a single spot in the garage. Other than that, great place to live.
It is very good. I am getting plenty of help on the phone whenever I have a question and the website is very easy to use. Overall, it is a great experience.
Its nice looking place from the outside but when you live there you’ll notice its faults. you can tell the building was made quickly and cheaply ( walls are very thin??). wish rent was cheaper
Ameneties are great, but there’s always so many closures. Staff is nice most of the time but seems inexperienced or rude other times. Overall pretty good.

The Hub is a very clean place with some great amenities. Laundry and dishwasher in house, each bedroom has an en-suite bathroom, great gym and pool areas, and some fun resident benefits/activities. Work orders get filled quickly and they’re quick to help you with problems that arise.
For the price you’re paying and proximity to campus, I highly recommend Hub Blacksburg. The amenities and fully furnished apartments are great and made move-in super simple.
Service requests can be slow if not marked urgent. Hallways rarely cleaned unless there is a biohazard. Other than those it’s a high quality complex with many amenities.
i'm so excited to live there. I can't wait to see the view and the apartment and the hot tub in the pool. The guest have been great. Everyone is communicating very well.
Very clean and modern style apartment. Location is great and convenient for transportation to campus. Amenities are great for staying at the apartment all day.
not a great complex to live at and management is not that great. Reply times tend to take a long time from them. Office has lost packages and lied about it.
it is really great living here at the hub. the amenities are extremely nice and it feels like a home away from home. i’m very happy with my living situation here.
Simply the best! So homey and cozy wherever you are in the building. The hub is always home. Everything is so beautiful in the building as well!
It has been a great experience so far where I was able to live in such a great atmosphere. The hub has given great luxury and has been one of the most infleuential places
Everything about the apartment was super nice, maintenance always came super fast. the building itself is really clean. customer service was always helpful and fixed any issues almost immediately.

Signing a lease can be a significant milestone, and my recent experience was surprisingly smooth and positive. The process began with a thorough online search, which led me to several promising listings. The property management team was incredibly responsive, addressing my queries promptly and scheduling viewings at convenient times.

Living in this community has been an exceptional experience from start to finish. From the moment I moved in, the staff have been incredibly welcoming and attentive, always going above and beyond to ensure every need is met.
Great! The hub is a great luxury apartment complex that is super attentive to each individual living here. I am very excited to be apart of such a great community

Pretty terrible management. The gym flooded last year for two months and was inaccessible. Now, it burned down for a month and has been unusable again. Refused to send me my lease so I've had to move units my senior year. They also switch wifi over the summer months to be slower than the school year.
Beautiful apartment building. The study rooms are amazing and produce a study conducive environment!  The amenities this apartment building provides is such a splendor!
There are many amenities available to use and various events in the lobby that happen from time to time. Front lobby staff is accommodating and helpful!

My time at the Hub Blacksburg has been great! The community is so welcoming and the activities held are great to meet new people! I plan on staying at the Hub for the remainder of my time I’m staying in Blacksburg!
It is wonderful and the community is welcoming as well as gave me tips and tricks on how to navigate the Hub as well as making sure I set up auto payments.

I love living at the hub!! all of the amenities are top notch and I love the cozy vibe of my unit!! the only thing I noticed was that the hot tubs outside are a little weird as I wasn't able to properly turn them on.
Very nice apartments, but gym is lacking a lot. Super easy to get to bus stops and walk to campus is short. Very pretty pool and good cleanliness.
Good. I liked the floor plans and apartment amenities. It was brand new when I moved in so everything was clean and the technology was slick and new.
so far, everything has been incredibly straight forward, and I feel heard and respected by the office. I’m so excited to move in, and hopefully it continues to be a smooth process!
great living space and amenities. The bus schedule also works out really well and allows for a fast way to campus without any hastle. It is also close to a bunch of great food places!
Something always seems to be broken and it’s the gym right now which is inconvenient. That being said it’s been good otherwise. Room for improvement.
I’ve lived at Hub Blacksburg for three years since they first opened. It has been a pretty good experience and the apartments are nicely located to campus.
The hub is a very nice place to live in. The staff are very nice, the rooms are also very nice. The walls, however, are very thin and I can whenever someone is walking in the apartment above me.

My experience living at the hub has been fantastic. The amenities are amazing and the location is very accessible with busses and to campus and surrounding apartments which is nice. Maintenance is good.
Appliances and infrastructure was okay. They’d break down but maintenance always responded in a timely manner! Overall, I highly enjoyed living at the Hub and its community!
pretty solid place to live. the amenities are the best part. some staff could just use a chill pill. however, i’ve enjoyed my time at the hub.

Overall, I have enjoyed my time at the hub. It really shines in its amenities (gym, pool, common areas, study rooms, etc). For a college apartment, it is nice.

However, if I had to choose apartments over again I would not live at the hub. When they switched management companies they jacked up the price and for the size of the apartment and how many maintenance issues there are it's not worth it. The building is in poor quality but looks aesthetically pleasing, essentially a luxury facade. Also the gym was unusable for most of the year and is now unusable again in the summer. The pools were opened super late. 

This review is directed at management and not any of the front desk workers or maintenance workers, who have been great and very helpful!
things in the common spaces break and they dont get replaced. everything is cheap. the only upside is the maintenance team is quick and dependable.

There are a surplus of amenities from multiple pools, a dog washing station, gym, sauna, dog parks, volleyball and basketball courts, etc. The downside of this is these amenities are often poorly kept. The hot tubs are cold or green 90% of the time, the gym equipment is frequently broken, and the doors that are opened by your key fob are often not properly functioning. The apartments themselves are nice but small and noise is a big issue. I lived here for 2 years, but never felt like it was worth the price of the rent.
The HUB Blacksburg is a good place to live if you are a student. As graduate student who has lived alone in the complex for two years I have been fairly happy here.
I love that the hub has a lot of events for their residents to make them feel loved! I also love how kind the staff are and how quickly maintanence comes
Going into my first year at the Hub I am super excited and ready to meet the community that surrounds me and experience the lavish amenities that the hub offers

The amenities, including a well-equipped gym, pristine pool, cozy lounge, and modern co-working space, are always well-maintained. The maintenance team is prompt and professional, resolving any issues quickly. Safety is excellent with gated entry and 24/7 security, creating a peaceful environment. The management organizes regular community events, fostering a strong sense of community. Overall, The Hub offers an outstanding living experience. I highly recommend it to anyone seeking a comfortable, safe, and vibrant place to call home.
Overall, great apartment with high quality amenities. However, walls are not very sound proof so you will likely hear your neighbors if they play music, even if it’s not loud.

I  enjoy the amenities, such as the study rooms. I also like how the interior of the apartment is very clean looking.  If you have any trouble then it is easy to contact a staff. The walls are pretty sound proof.

FYI they take down reviews that make them look bad, but I am not lying about anything I've said here.

The bedrooms are really small for the price (I asked 3 times for a square footage before I moved in). Mine is actually decent sized and I'm totally happy, but my roommates have way smaller rooms. 

The fire alarm has gone off over 10 times unannounced. I haven't heard it in a while, however. It's a new building, so it will have some kinks, but they should have silenced it instead of letting it go on for 2  hours. 

They didn't give any instructions on how to take care of the hot tubs and are not furnishing chemicals like they promised at the beginning (nothing in lease, but PM is not owning her word). It's kind of a health hazard for the other people living here who might not know how to take care of theirs. 

The internet is bad in our bedrooms but great in the living room, and we've asked over 5 times for them to fix it this month. They still have not. It's due to  long shipping times for booster modems, which is understandable, but they should have tested and ordered before move in. 

Construction is always blocking up the road during the most prominent school hours. They are ALL over the place with their punch list and seem completely disorganized.  They need to focus on one area and move on. 

Also, they didn't pro rate the rent, which means they are still taking a "security deposit" of about $750, but the only difference from a deposit is that you won't get it back. Kinda sneaky. 

The only reason I'm writing this is because some of those items might get fixed if I post this. There's TONS of great things about the hub as well. Overall, I'm glad I live here. I'll change my review once these points are addressed.

Our Blacksburg apartments put you in the center of it all and inspire you to experience everything the city has to offer.

reviewsList.text: Please do not waste your money moving here. My room was a shoe box compared to all the  others in the house (even though I was told all rooms are the same size), yet i was paying the same amount. The floor was disgusting and even had gum in it. The management was horrible in terms of their attitude and deceptiveness. I was lied to several times by them and they’re just plain rude. Overall horrible quality of living, especially for the amount being payed. Wouldn’t even live here for free to be honest.
So happy living here! The staff is super helpful and the clubhouse is a great place to study and work! I love going to the resident events but wish they had more.
great benefits, perks, great maintenance and staff, would recommend living here for student housing,  lively, great surrounding area, nearby activities
Love it here, and love the cottage. I love the lobby and I use the coffee machine all the time, I also love the other amenities, and wish we use the pool more

Great experience all around during my time at Virginia Tech. The Retreat is very home-like in the apartments and the community as a whole. I recommend checking this place out when looking for student housing!
Great place to live, management is always incredibly helpful, amenities are the best, maintenance is always quick and efficient, there is not a better place to live in the area.

I have lived at the retreat for 4 years and the roommates that I got randomly matched with have become my very best friends and family. The staff is so welcoming and helpful! My maintenance man Steven always has a smile on his face and does job well. The amenities have been pretty good too. I enjoy using the 2 story gym when I can, and the pool is nice during the summer. Thanks Retreat!

The Retreat isn't like other apartments in Blacksburg. These are little houses. There's backyards & large grass areas for neighbor games and socializing. The pool is awesome and the sauna & golf are great too. They have a big clubhouse with free coffee & snacks & they office staff are wonderful to talk too. Maintenance is quick to fix anything and I would recommend this place to anyone!
I love that the Retreat is always hosting resident events and the staff are always friendly and seem happy to help the residents. I also like the free snacks & starbucks in the clubhouse.
This is my second year living at the Retreat and I'm now renewing for a third year. Staff are super nice and I love the events!
I have really loved living here, the location is ideal and the maintenance and management team has been great! I brought some of my friends to live here too, and they love it.

I lived in apartments on Patrick Henry last year & I'm glad that me & my roommates moved to the retreat. The cottage feels like home & it's really nice to have a community of neighbors around. The gym is opened 24/7 & I like that I can go get free starbucks in the middle of the night. It's the best place to live by far!

My parents & I stopped by the office yesterday to see the model again & the staff were great! They answered all of my parent's questions & made us feel very welcome. She also said we can make event suggestions & gave me her card to email her if we have ideas or questions later. We can't wait to move in this August!

I love the Retreat & have only had positive experiences living here. I reported the dog park fence lock not working & Becky sent people over there to fix it the same day. All the staff are nice & approachable. Best CS in town! Don't waste your time and $$ on UCB, just live here already!
This place is amazing, the woman in the office is the best and they are very accommodating.

Looking into living area for my daughter at va tech.i was very impressed with the amenities at the retreat.very clean,management was very helpful and it's very close to campus and they have bus service at the location.

The retreat staff is super friendly and helpful. The tour really gave me an idea about what it was going to be like living at the retreat. I really love the amenities, like the pool, the gym, and the quiet study rooms perfect getting my homework done. There is also a walking path the goes around the property. This makes it easy to walk our dog since the retreat is pet friendly! I love living here so much I am living here next year too!

I genuinely would give zero stars if I could. The absolute lack of care this building shows for its residents is insane.

Thee hot tub and fire pit has been broken for the ENTIRE year so far. I express my wish for them to repaired almost every day it feels like. They do nothing about it. 
They finally got cycling bikes I'd been begging for in the gym but the seat moves angles so its unusable and they refuse to make the vendors come do it promptly. 
I lived here over the summer with my dog and I would have a melt down everyday because maintenance people would come in whenever they pleased unannounced. I would be frantic my dog would get out while I was at work. I expressed my frustration every day, they didn't care. 
the maintenance people have let my friends dog out before. 

Overall, this complex is cheaply built and looks nice from the outside but will be the worst place you ever live if you decide to sign a lease here. The management doesn't care about the residents. Never live here.

The retreat is a great place to live, but there are things wrong with some apartments. We’ve had to call maintenance a few too many times. The gym is nice and the clubhouse is a great place to study.

I love living here. The amenities are all great, always clean, and the staff is always super nice. The Retreat does a great job with making the residents feel at home. I couldn't imagine living anywhere else.
The staff here is amazing and helpful. The location is great
very fun place to live, i love the clubhouse and friendly staff. the walking/running path also another perk! feels like a community rather than a cookie cutter apt complex

I really love the location and the fact that we have our own bus route that drops you right off at the clubhouse. Each cottage offers the chance for you to have space to yourself but also come together with your roommates which is really nice. Often they host free food giveaways and fun Instagram contests. I have really enjoyed my time here and look forward to another year of living here. My car however, does not appreciate the rough speed bumps but I guess that’s a minor issue.

I have only had positive experiences living here these past two years and would recommend The Retreat to anyone who asked for housing in Blacksburg. All the amenities here are hard to beat. The staff here are incredibly nice and welcoming and makes you feel at home with most staff knowing you by name. Maintenance is very quick to complete maintenance request usually same day turnover. I am a graduating senior and will miss The Retreat very much.

I’m a transfer student to VT and the retreat has been one of the best places to live by far I’ve met so many cool people and also have had the best roommates the pool is also excellent not to mention the gym has a lot of different equipment.
I love living at the Retreat because the staff and leasing office is very friendly and very attentive to our needs as residents!

After bouncing around a few apartment complexes in my 5 years at Tech, I can definitively say The Retreat has been my best living experience while in Blacksburg. Friendly staff, comfortable living spaces and the pool and clubhouse amenities make it the perfect place to stay while studying at VT!

Most people expect college living situations to be ratty apartments but The Retreat exceeds these expectations. Every amenity is top tier and the staff is so friendly! Overall the best place to live in Blacksburg for sure.

The Retreat is more than a place to live in Blacksburg. It offers you a home away from home with a resort style feel. The Retreat offers amenities such as the PGA golf simulator, resort style pool, beach style volleyball, infare sauna, complimentary Starbucks coffee, and more. Most importantly, the office staff and maintenance team cultivates an atmosphere of comfortability and mutual respect. Most definitely check this place out if you are looking for housing in near Virginia Tech.

I love it here! All the amenities in the clubhouse are such a plus. The study rooms, golf simulator, and pool are amaaazing. The house itself is modern and spacious. I love having my own bathroom and walk- in closet. I can’t wait to live here for another year

LOVE this place! Have no complaints at all! Maintenance comes out the day of, or day after you call and report a problem (which we barely do), and the amenities are amazing! Anyone who wants a place where you feel like your at home, this is the place for you!

My son has lived at the Retreat for 2 years while attending Virginia Tech. The amenities in the cottage and in the clubhouse, along with the pool, are amazing! The cottages are spacious and comfortable. The staff is always friendly and accommodating. It's a great place to call home! If he wasn't graduating this Spring, he would definitely be staying for another year!
Beautiful place to live. Workers are always friendly.

The Retreat is a fun community filled with respectful people. The employees are on top of maintenance and other needs of residents. Have 24/7 access to the pool and sauna is an added bonus! I’m living here for the second year in a row next year and can’t wait!

I have lived at the retreat for 2 years now and have loved every minute of it. My favorite thing about living here is having my own bathroom and the clubhouse. The clubhouse is a great place to study with the many seats and free printing as well as free coffee. Living here has definitely made it easier for me to focus on my studying.

The Retreat has exceeded all my expectations. The staff and amenities are the best of the best. I am so happy with what I have gained from living at The Retreat that I have renewed my lease and will be living here again next year !
The Retrear is an awesome place to live with a great sense of community! The cottages are very nice and spacious. There is also a club house with free coffee, pool tables, a gym and much more! -K

Although it may seem like a high price, so much is included. Starbucks coffee machine, gym, sauna, study rooms, pool, spa & so much more. There’s so many events and free food as well as contests. The community atmosphere is really great and you really get to know the staff.
Great place with lots of amenities. Cottages are nice and spacious. Large rooms and personal bathrooms. Only downside is parking. - CM

They offer a large variety of styles/number of rooms. Pool is wonderful and the place to be when the suns out. Dog park is great because the retreat loves fur friends! I’ve lived here for 2.5 years and wouldn’t change my mind. -Lizzy S.
Beautiful, clean place to live with great amenities!!
This is an amazing place to live. They allow pets and have a great dog park. The pool is wonderful, along with other great amenities.

Great place to live! I have stayed here for 2 years and I am very happy living here! Rent can be pricey depending on which complex you are at, but the amenities are wonderful here for the price you pay and it's very close to campus! There are a lot of giveaway opportunities and community events. Staff are extremely friendly. Maintenance arrives timely. The reason I give this place a 4/5 is because some homes have a few flaws (i.e. bathroom light installed outside of bathroom, back door isn't well insulated to keep out the cold, poor trims, etc.). Other than that, I love this place!
Ill be living here next year for the third year in a row! The amenities are amazing and the cottages are so roomy!! My roommates and I have loved it!

I have now enjoyed living at the retreat for about 8 months and I couldn’t be happier, the cottages are so comfortable and spacious! The clubhouse and its amenities are just top notch! I would change my cottage life for anything!

These are really nice houses to live in ESPECIALLY with good, nice roommates! Houses are spacious, clubhouse is always clean, and free coffee!!!

-Z

I love living at the Retreat! I’ve had nothing but a positive experience with the staff and the amenities. Because of the Retreat’s amazing community events I have made some of my closest friends here. I definitely recommend this place!
I LOVE living here! The cottage style neighborhood makes it feel super homey and the rooms are perfect sizes. The prices is worth it because there are so many benefits!

My roommates and I have lived at the retreat for 3 years. The best thing about our 4 bedroom is how much space we have to spread out and entertain. It's amazing to be able to just walk out our back door versus climbing multiple floors to leave our apartment and sit outside. We will miss this place when we graduate this May :( :(
I never want to leave the Retreat! Everything is so fun and convenient. It makes student living feel like a vacation!

I have only been living a The Retreat but I absolutely love it! Maintenance team is very quick at fulfilling requests and I never have a problem with staff. It is an excellent place to spend your off-campus life at and I high recommend!
Honestly amazing amenities and contests or give aways all the time for residents. Any issues they come immediately to help. - M.B.

This is my second year living here. It was wonderful last year and has only gotten better. The facilities are top notch. If we ever have problems, maintenance shows up very fast. I would recommend to anyone!
Awesome staff and amenities! Love having a bus stop on the property and the frequent events at the clubhouse.

Love love love living here! I always have felt super safe & love having my own private bathroom and walk in closet. Loves of space, friendly staff and great amenities. Everything was in good condition when I moved in. Rooms are a little on the smaller side, but with a huge walk in bathroom, huge living space, personal bathroom, and balcony you don’t even notice!! Also pool is super fun when it is warm out. Great community.

listings.desc:
PRIVATE ROOM SUBLET — SERIOUS FEMALE STUDENT
Huntington Ln | 3-Bedroom Townhouse | $692 Rent | $762 Deposit

Has a possibility of being extended through the end of Spring semester. 

A private bedroom is available in a 3-bedroom townhouse on Huntington Ln with 2 full bathrooms and 2 half bathrooms. The available bedroom has a shared bathroom. The home is shared with two other serious female students who are focused on school and maintaining a quiet, respectful, study-oriented household. Transit includes two bus stops outside with a 15 minute ride to campus (Academic Side).

THIS IS A SERIOUS STUDENT HOME
This is not a party house or a place for someone looking for a constant stream of visitors. The ideal roommate is someone who:
Takes school seriously
Wants a quiet, peaceful place to live and study
Is responsible, mature, clean, and respectful
Pays rent on time
Respects the other roommates' privacy and schedules
Is considerate of noise and shared spaces
Understands and agrees to the household rules


NON-NEGOTIABLE HOUSE RULES
NO PARTIES.
NO OVERNIGHT GUESTS.
NO UNAUTHORIZED OCCUPANTS.
NO LOUD OR DISRUPTIVE BEHAVIOR.

The townhouse is intended to remain a quiet, clean, peaceful, study-focused home.
If you are looking for a place to host parties, have frequent visitors, entertain late at night, or maintain a highly social lifestyle, this is not the right living arrangement for you.

ROOM & HOUSE
Private bedroom
Shared bathroom
3-bedroom townhouse
2 full bathrooms
2 half bathrooms
Shared kitchen
Shared common areas
Quiet, academically focused environment
Two other serious female student roommates


RENT, DEPOSIT & UTILITIES
Current monthly rent: $692
Current security deposit: $762
Rent and security deposit may be negotiable for the right person
Tenant pays 1/3 of all utilities (Atmos Energy, Appalachian Power, Blacksburg Utility)


SUBLET TERM & POSSIBLE SPRING 2027 ARRANGEMENT
The sublet is available from August 25, 2026 through December 25, 2026.
The term is negotiable, and there may be an opportunity to continue through the end of the Spring 2027 semester. 
The existing lease allows for the possibility of having a 4th roommate. If one of the current tenants obtains a co-op for the Spring 2027 semester, the living arrangements may change. Depending on the Spring 2027 situation, the subtenant may be able to remain in the same bedroom for the Spring semester.

If all four students remain in the townhouse for Spring 2027, however, the subtenant would need to move to the basement area. The basement is not a walk-out basement. Therefore, someone interested in staying through Spring 2027 should be comfortable with either possibility:
Option 1: Remain in the current bedroom if the Spring 2027 living arrangement allows it.
Option 2: Move to the basement area if all four students remain in the townhouse.
The Spring 2027 arrangement is dependent on the final housing and co-op situation and cannot be guaranteed at this time.

WHO SHOULD INQUIRE
This room is intended for a serious female student who wants a quiet and responsible living environment and is willing to respect the household rules. Please include in your initial message:
Your name
A brief introduction about yourself
Your expected move-in date
How long you are interested in staying
Confirmation that you understand and agree to the no parties and no overnight guests policy

listings.name: Foxridge Apartment Homes

reviewsList.text: Amenities are better than all the new buildings in town, its a nice park like setting which is a reprieve from all the student communities on the north side of town. Maintenance service is attentive and my apartment is spacious and upgraded! Bus to campus runs all the time and takes about 15 minutes.
I love the location of Foxridge because it is more isolated than other complexes. The trails around the area are a very nice addition. Maintenance is also very responsive.

Through almost a year living at Foxridge Apartments my room mate and I had no issue at all with the management. This changed when we indicated that we were interested in resigning our lease early into the school year (around October). Foxridge didn't present a new lease to us until after winter break and increased our rent without any notification besides that on the lease. It seems very unprofessional for a company to surprise good tenants (who are also students without a notable income) by sneaking in price increases late into the apartment hunting season, which severely limited any other option.

First of all the office is extremely unhelpful and rude. They have hung up on me and rarely answer the phones at all. Maybe they technically have a security, but nothing is done. I have seen cars keyed, ive been hit by a car on the sidewalk outside my building, and parked cars hit and run. Our entire building had many packages stolen (I lived on the third floor) and even laundry taken from washing machines. Their only response was to send a letter out informing people. We already knew packages were getting stolen. They made no actual effort to make their residences feel more safe. The thefts never stopped. The maintenance workers are super nice and helpful, which are the only people who care about you. Ive lived there for two and a half years. Even though Virginia law states they are not allowed to charge for normal wear and tear, they consider only scratches on the wall to be normal wear and tear. They dont consider light bulbs to be wear and tear, which legally it is (trust me I checked.) But we are students and obviously cant take them to court. The carpet second year, my dog chewed up in the corner. Totally needed to be changed and I accepted that charge. But expect to lose your entire deposit and possible even pay them more. Both apartments I lived in had rats and bats in the walls. I could hear them moving around in the ceiling often, even after they use their exterminator. They recently changed the washing machines by letting you pay on your phone. They didn't change the actual machines that have put holes in lots of clothes. They then made it .75 more to use each machine, even if you use quarters. Now its 1.50 for each machine. Year one, they charged us to change the carpets even though they hadnt been changed in years and nothing was done to them besides walking on it. They charged us for the carpet because they hadnt been changed in years and were changing them in every unit. They will charge you at any chance they can and still have the nerve to treat you badly. They dont care about their tenants just money. Its so unfortunate that its run by these people because the building, property, and bus system was great. But because of who its run by, the quality of living is crappy. No matter how much you clean, no matter how long/ how much effort you put to reach their standards; it wont matter. They will charge you anyways. I spent hours bleaching and scrubbing the bathroom and still was charged. Choose more wisely then I did.

I lived in this apartment community for 19 months and I moved out on Sunday and they did not do inspection while I was there because it's a holiday and then I was surprised to see some the charges they deducted and they will politely deny everything you say to encounter the charges and they do not keep any proofs of apartment condition when you move in apart from the inspection sheet that you fill up when you move in. So, I am sure lot of students will be moving into this apartment but be aware and keep note of following,
- Do not move in or move out on holidays. (they expect you to move out on weekdays if you want to have the inspection even though they will charge you for weekends or holidays if your move-out falls in that). So, best bet for you is to have move-out date on lease agreement as one of the week days.
- Make sure to take pictures of apartments (each and every single stuff) and also when you move out. This is very helpful when you are dealing with this kind people.
- Fill out move-in inspection sheet in detail assuming you are moving into a brand new apartment (even though it's over 40 years old apartment community). There will be lots of things which may not be available as checklist but do write them all. (e.g. use finger to see if air vent is clean, use hand to see if bathtub, wash basin, kitchen basin, kitchen floor, etc are not sticky and write them if it's, make sure to write even if there is a single spot in carpet). These carpets are freaking at least 10 years old, but they will charge you if you have not written anything on inspection sheet.

Management is pathetic, rude. I will never ever live in this community if I happen to come to Blacksburg again and even won't recommend.

"Dollar Tree will return your dollar even if you lose your receipts but Foxridge/Heathwood management won't. Leasing office people are so terrible."

Becareful about which building you tour...your parking spot may not always be available and non residents can register with the office to use the parking lot it seems. Lived here for years and management doesn't care enough to make sure us paying residents have spaces for ourselves or guests. You have been warned.

This is the perfect complex if you're looking for a quiet environment and that "home feeling". The maintenance staff is always looking out for you and always quick with repairs or issues. Your rent includes water and heat which is awesome come winter time in Blacksburg, VA. Also the buses come every 15 minutes and the walk is short to every stop.
Bus stops are in weird places and it's more expensive than it should be, but the places are nice.

Good bus route access,  a little pricey. Has a pool and a gym and all that. Floors are a little thin so if you're on the bottom floor you can easily hear the people above you. But the apartments themselves are pretty nice and mostly roomy. Living area is large and bedrooms are a good size. A little out of the way from downtown and campus but we'll worth it.

Hethwood and Foxridge are really great apartments to live in. It is a bit pricey, but being in a college town, the prices are worth it for the perks! Maintenance is great and we can always count on the staff to take care of anything we need in a very timely manner. The neighborhood is awesome and everyone is very friendly. I highly recommend Foxridge/Hethwood!

this apartment complex has the best amenities! I enjoy the pools and fitness center. The walking trail is right behind my house which is great for exercising. The management is great too so helpful and concerned. Great place!!!!

reviewsList.text: Want an incredible vista of the mountains around Blacksburg?  As the hero George remarks in A Room with a View, "We have a view!"  Our balcony overlooks the mountain range surrounding our area.  In the fall, the trees on the mountains burst into a symphony of color.  We often eat dinner on our balcony, just to watch the sunset.  And after all, what other reason to move to southwest Virginia than to experience the beauty of nature?  We also have a 24-hour gym, gorgeously landscaped pool, and ample parking in our complex.  Management was very responsive to our requests for apartment upgrades when we moved in, and we're thrilled with the state of our place!  Windsor Hills is close enough to downtown to allow easy access to restaurants and shopping and far enough away from the hubbub to be peaceful and quiet on weekends (the complex is located in a residential area just at the edge of a rural stretch of land).  The best part is that there is a "time check" bus station steps from our door that goes directly to Virginia Tech campus for a no-hassle workday.

Nice fairly large apartments for a good price. It can sometimes be hard to find a 2 person apartment for the same price per person as a 4 person but Windsor Hills does a good job, I pay just over $400 a month. Also Windsor Hills is very dog friendly with a dog park and location wise it is one of the best in terms of only having to take one bus that goes directly through downtown and to campus. Can't argue that places like the Edge or downtown apartments are significantly more higher end but the prices are a completely different class and honestly a working college student just can't afford it without significant contributions from a parent.

If you have pets, this is the place for you. Pet friendly, with a dog park within walking distance. Lounge by the pool or work out at the gym. Within walking distance of downtown, you can enjoy hanging out with your friends at the local bars and restaurants. Conveniently located on the bus line, which will take you any and everywhere you need to go!

reviewsList.text: I move around a lot for school. I lived in The Reserve for two years and I have to say it was my absolute favorite apartment complex to live in. The apartments are so spacious and the new, sturdy, quality appliances are so impressive (I'm learning how much that makes a difference while in my new place). The parking lot lights are bright so I always felt safe walking into my apartment at night. Not to mention during the day, the apartment complex has the most breathtaking view of mountains in the distance. The pool is gorgeous and the clubhouse is to die for! They host fun events with REAL food. Every person I came in contact with were so kind. The front office was full of smiling faces and they were always willing to help. Matt, a leasing staff member, even helped me bring a huge box up into my apartment because it was too heavy for me. That's just one example of how nice they are! My maintenance work orders were also completed so fast!! Sometimes even within the same hour. Even the move out process was quick and smooth (no sketchy hidden bills like other places). I have no complaints and you won't either! Go see for yourself! You won't be disappointed.

Just wanted to give a huge Hokie SHOUT OUT to The Reserve at Knollwood apartment complex - my daughter lived there this past year with 2 other girls and it was such a pleasant experience. They are responsive, easy to deal with, parking was never a hassle, they offer wonderful amenities and I always felt that she was safe.  Highly recommend!

listings.desc: The Reserve at Knollwood is close to the Virginia Tech® campus and airport, and only minutes away from some of the New River Valley's finest shopping, dining and entertainment. Two fireplaces add character to the living spaces; however, both fireplaces are non-functioning and are provided for decorative use only.
  Outside, residents can enjoy a large deck overlooking the yard, mature landscaping, and off-street parking. An electric heat pump provides heating and air conditioning.
  Cat and small dogs (under 30 lbs) welcome. Limit of three pets.
  DUE TO ZONING REQUIREMENTS NO MORE THEN THREE UNRELATED PEOPLE MAY OCCUPY THE HOME.
  To submit an application go to  
  $78.50 non-refundable application fee per applicant (18+)
  All residents 18+ must apply and be on the lease
  Pet Policy:
  Pet application required via  (additional fees may apply)
  $300 non-refundable pet fee
  $60/month pet rent per pet
  Other Requirements:
  $225 lease preparation fee due at signing
  Renter’s insurance required

  Real Property Management Insight has a brokerage relationship the the Landlord of this property and represents only the Landlord.

  Real Property Management Insight complies with all federal, state, and local fair housing laws and does not discriminate based on protected classes. Reasonable accommodations and modifications are available as required by law.
